name: Forging the Shaft
summary: After The Flawless Flame, Kalaran Windblade says that holding the flawless flame takes both a shaft and a casing, and the shaft must come first. The Dark Iron slavers and taskmasters of the cauldron use enchanted thorium weapons, and eight thorium plated daggers can be reforged into a shaft.

sections.title: Enchanted Alloy
sections.body: A shaft and a casing are both needed, Kalaran says, to hold the flawless flame. The slavers and taskmasters of the Dark Irons in the cauldron fight with enchanted thorium, a metal of great sturdiness. Kalaran can break eight of their thorium plated daggers down and reforge the alloy into a shaft.

sections.title: A Sharp Tongue
sections.body: When the daggers are delivered, Kalaran has no thanks to give, only jeering. You are called an exceptional laborer and asked whether you ever thought of a different vocation: detective, junk collector, or one of those silly gnomes who comb the beaches of Azeroth with metal-detecting contraptions, hunting lost treasure.

faq.q: Why does Kalaran need thorium plated daggers?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade can break their alloy down and reforge it into a shaft to help hold the flawless flame.
Dark Iron slavers and taskmasters in the cauldron fight with weapons of enchanted thorium.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the chain?
aliases: what quest comes before forging the shaft
faq.answer: It follows The Flawless Flame, in which you gathered materials for the torch of flawless flame.
Kalaran asks for eight thorium plated daggers.
